system.name: dLoRA
system.one_liner: an LLM serving system that dynamically batches and migrates LoRA adapters and requests across replicas for better utilization and load balancing

components.name: Load Balancer
components.role: routes requests and triggers adapter/request migration across replicas

components.name: ILP Solver
components.role: solves an integer linear program to plan migration

components.name: LLM Replicas
components.role: a cluster of GPU replicas serving multiple LoRA adapters

components.name: Cross-adapter Batching
components.role: batches requests to different LoRA adapters together on one GPU

components.name: Global Monitor
components.role: monitors cluster-wide load for migration decisions

content.key_idea: dLoRA's Load Balancer proactively dispatches requests and reactively plans adapter/request migrations via an ILP solver, while LLM Replicas batch requests across different LoRA adapters sharing a base model on each GPU.
content.reading_order: Left panel (Load Balancer: proactive dispatch, reactive ILP-based migration planning) sends Requests and Migration traffic right, into the LLM Replicas panel (cross-adapter batching, migration controller, global monitor).

summary: This figure shows the overall two-panel architecture of dLoRA, a system that serves multiple LoRA adapters on a cluster of GPU replicas. The left dashed panel, Load Balancer, dispatches incoming requests via a Proactive Mechanism (a Balance Dispatcher) and plans rebalancing via a Reactive Mechanism (an ILP Solver producing a Migration Plan, triggered by a Re-balance Trigger). The right dashed panel, LLM Replicas, shows stacked GPUs each running Cross-adapter Batching over a shared Base Model with per-request Adapter 0/Adapter 1 weights, plus Memory Management; a Migration Controller and a Global Monitor sit alongside the replica stack. Requests and Migration arrows cross between the two panels, matching the text's description of within-replica cross-adapter batching and across-replica dynamic migration for load balancing.
summary_zh: 该图展示 dLoRA 两栏架构：左侧 Load Balancer（主动分发、反应式 ILP 求解与再均衡）向右侧 LLM Replicas（跨适配器批处理、迁移控制器、全局监控）发送请求并迁移。
